description: Find campsites, glamping sites and holiday parks that use Campiamo (the public directory plus every Campiamo-hosted campsite website). Filter by free text (name, town, county, country, description), country, amenities and, with dates, live availability and total stay price for the party. Returns each campsite's slug for the other tools.

amenities.description: Facilities that must be present, e.g. ["electric hook-up", "showers", "dogs"].

check_out.description: Departure date, YYYY-MM-DD. Must be after check_in.

country.description: Country name or ISO code, e.g. "UK", "France", "NZ".

query.description: Free text: a place, region, campsite name or keyword such as "lake" or "glamping".

name: search_campsites
title: Search campsites
